CI sets TEST_POSTGRES_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://rmm:rmm@127.0.0.1:5432/rmm_test (.github/workflows/ci.yml:168). Locally (SQLite default) these are skipped. test_migrations.py:935 requires the URL to point to an EMPTY disposable DB; prepared_db cleans up to preserve that assumption.

dashboard_proxy: src/proxy.ts (Next 16 proxy convention, replaces middleware.ts; no middleware.ts exists). matcher: '/login' only. It calls sanitizedLoginUrl(request.nextUrl) and redirects to /login with the query stripped if ?email or ?password is present (keeps credentials out of URLs); otherwise NextResponse.next(). It gates nothing auth-wise: no API route or page is protected by proxy; auth is per-route/page via getDashboardSession or cookie checks. Coverage: sanitizedLoginUrl is unit-tested in test/dashboard-auth-core.test.ts (L12, L67-70); proxy() itself and its matcher config are untested.
production_smoke: scripts/production-smoke.mjs (npm run smoke:production; requires prior `npm run build`). Spins up an in-process mock NodeLink API (node:http) on a random port and runs `next start` with NODE_ENV=production, NODELINK_API_BASE_URL pointed at the mock. Mock handles POST /api/v1/auth/login, GET /auth/me, /patch-approval/policies, /enrollment-dashboard, /clients/navigation, GET+POST /enrollment-tokens, POST /enrollment-tokens/{id}/revoke, GET /agents, /agents/{id}, POST /agents/{id}/revoke, GET /audit/events; anything else 404, non-'Bearer smoke-session' 401. Assertions: anonymous /enrollment redirects to /login (or renders login nav); anonymous POST /api/enrollment-tokens -> 401; POST /api/auth/login -> 200 with HttpOnly+Secure cookie; pages /enrollment, /enrollment/tokens, /enrollment/tokens/new, /enrollment/agents, /enrollment/agents/{id}, /enrollment/audit, /patch-policies render 200 with expected text and never leak the one-time token; patch-policies nav aria markup; POST /api/enrollment-tokens without Origin -> 403 (CSRF); with Origin -> 201 and returns plaintext token; POST token revoke and agent revoke -> 200; token list shows masked token. Writes no real data (mock API only, in-memory, stateless). NOT run in CI: ci.yml dashboard job runs validate:env, lint, typecheck, npm test, build, then a curl page-load smoke that only greps /login for 'Sign in to operations'.
dom_libs_note: devDependencies: @tailwindcss/postcss, @types/node ^20, @types/react, @types/react-dom, eslint, eslint-config-next, tailwindcss, typescript. No jsdom, happy-dom, @testing-library/*, vitest, jest, or playwright in package.json or node_modules. Runner is bare `node --experimental-strip-types --test <explicit file list>` (Node >=24 <25 per engines); new test files must be added to the script by hand or they become orphans. Strip-types cannot handle JSX/.tsx or the @/ path alias, so component tests would need a loader/transpiler plus a DOM shim. tsconfig: allowImportingTsExtensions, moduleResolution bundler, jsx react-jsx, paths @/* -> ./src/*.
injection_shape: src/app/api/operators/route.ts L17-29: thin adapters `export function GET(request)` -> `handleListOperators(request, { getSession: getDashboardSession, listOperators })`, POST -> `handleCreateOperator(request, { createOperator, getSession: getDashboardSession })`; real deps imported from @/lib/dashboard-session (server-only, cookies()+/auth/me) and @/lib/operator-management (nodelinkApiRequest wrappers). Dynamic routes await context.params first then pass the id positionally (e.g. operators/[operatorId]/role/route.ts). operator-management-route-core.ts: imports only relative ./*.ts (no @/ alias, no server-only, no next/*) so node --experimental-strip-types can load it; L20-30 defines a structural RouteSession union {anonymous|unavailable|authenticated{operator.role,sessionToken}} and SessionDependency {getSession}; L52-71 requireAdmin (catch->503, anonymous->401, unavailable->503, non-admin->403); L46-50 isSameOriginRequest via dashboard-auth-core; L73-91 upstreamError/actionError map thrown {status,code} to describeOperatorActionError; L93-98 operatorResponse allowlists via operatorRecordFromUnknown (502 on invalid); each handler signature is (request, [id,] dependencies: SessionDependency & { <apiFn>: (sessionToken, ...) => Promise<unknown> }) returning Response (L100-148 list/create, L150+ grant/revoke/role/status). admin-sessions-route-core and mfa-route-core instead return {response, cookies[]} which admin-sessions-route.ts / mfa-route.ts (server-only, untested) apply via NextResponse.cookies.set. Test to copy: test/operator-management-route-core.test.ts - node:test + node:assert/strict; imports handlers from ../src/lib/operator-management-route-core.ts; fixtures: dashboardOrigin const, sentinel sessionToken/password strings, `adminSession = async () => ({kind:'authenticated', operator:{role:'admin'}, sessionToken})`, `request(path, method, body?, origin)` builds a WHATWG Request with Origin header, `upstreamOperator(extra)` builds server-shaped JSON; tests pass inline fake deps that record calls (e.g. `let called=false; createOperator: async()=>{called=true; ...}`) and assert response.status, `called===false` on cross-origin, and that sentinels never appear in response text/console.

inventory_hash_vector: Go agent/internal/inventory/inventory.go:112 ContentHash = sha256(json.Marshal(map)); Python server/app/schemas/inventory.py:597 canonical_inventory_bytes = json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) (ensure_ascii default True). Only cross-language pin is the EMPTY payload digest 44136fa3...ff8a, duplicated in agent/internal/inventory/inventory_test.go:16 (TestContentHashMatchesPinnedCrossLanguageVectors) and server/tests/test_inventory.py:127; not in contracts/test-vectors. Non-empty payloads are not pinned. Suspected (from code reading, not verified) divergence: Go json.Marshal HTML-escapes <,>,& as \u003c etc. and emits raw UTF-8, while Python escapes non-ASCII as \uXXXX and leaves <>& raw -> any section containing non-ASCII (e.g. (R)/(C) in software names) or <>& hashes differently, causing perpetual 'changed' resends. Float formatting (1e21, -0) may also differ. Command envelope canonicalization handles this explicitly (ensure_ascii=False, U+2028/2029) but inventory does not.

change_discipline:
Security-sensitive behavior requires unit and integration tests across every
affected boundary. Windows service, installer, signing, and credential changes
also require Windows tests. Keep this document, the threat model, deployment
readiness, and relevant runbooks synchronized with code in the same pull
request.
